dateNote.en: Dates identify each source’s publication, update or observation date.
dateNote.zh: 日期标明各资料的发布、更新或观察时间。

sources.title: Queensway Shopping Centre

context.en: Heritage-trail account. Sources give opening years from 1974 to 1976; the site presents the mid-1970s. Heritage-trail inclusion and statutory conservation are separate designations.
context.zh: 历史步道介绍。来源记载的开业年份介于 1974 至 1976 年，网站采用 1970 年代中期。历史步道收录与法定保育属于不同认定。

sources.title: My Queenstown Heritage Trail
sources.publisher: My Community; hosted by National Heritage Board, Roots

context.en: My Community publication hosted by NHB. It records a 1974 opening and historical construction cost; the website places the opening in the mid-1970s. Image rights remain with their holders.
context.zh: My Community 出版、NHB 托管。册中记载 1974 年开业及历史建造成本，网站将开业时间放在 1970 年代中期。影像权利归相应权利人。

sources.title: Alexandra

context.en: Regional historical account; the date identifies the information-valid-as-at date.
context.zh: 地区历史介绍；日期表示资料有效截至日。

sources.title: Queensway Shopping Centre en bloc attempt faces challenge from shop owners

context.en: Reporting on the 2019 collective-sale attempt, including a marketing-agent estimate and individual owners’ views.
context.zh: 关于 2019 年整售尝试的报道，包括营销代理估计与个别业主的观点。

sources.title: Queensway Shopping Centre’s en-bloc bid falls through; some shop owners rejoice

context.en: Reporting on the conclusion of the 2019 attempt. The 2026 date is a page update.
context.zh: 关于 2019 年整售尝试结束的报道；2026 年日期为网页更新日期。

sources.title: Large unit at Queensway Shopping Centre put on market for S$7.5m

context.en: Historical asking price for one unit. Tenancy information is attributed to the marketing agent.
context.zh: 单个单位的历史挂牌要价；租约信息引自营销代理。

sources.title: About Us
sources.publisher: Queensway Shopping Centre / MCST No. 572 website

context.en: Undated management description. Its 1976 opening year is one of the dates reported across the historical sources.
context.zh: 管理方介绍，未标明发布日期；其记载的 1976 年为历史来源中的开业年份之一。

sources.title: Sports store directory
sources.publisher: Queensway Shopping Centre / MCST No. 572 website

context.en: Business directory entries, describing the businesses named by the directory.
context.zh: 商户目录条目，介绍目录列出的商家。

context.en: Reported experiences of owners and traders in strata malls.
context.zh: 关于分层产权商场业主与商户经历的报道。

sources.title: Amazing Vintage Haul at Queensway Shopping Centre

context.en: A dated promotion featuring vintage shops. Its date identifies the promotion.
context.zh: 介绍古着店的推广文章，日期对应推广发布。

sources.title: More than just sportswear: Retirees find second wind at Queensway Shopping Centre

context.en: Published interviews about individual retirees’ experiences at Queensway.
context.zh: 关于个别退休人士在女皇道经历的公开采访。

sources.title: The Morphology of Activity Centers, the Commons, and Shopping Malls in Multicultural Singapore

context.en: Publisher’s abstract of the research paper.
context.zh: 出版方提供的论文摘要。

sources.title: Matters under LTSA

context.en: Collective-sale procedure and consent measured by share value and strata area. This source records the framework before the 2026 amendment.
context.zh: 集体出售程序，以及按产权份额和分层面积计算的同意门槛。该来源记录 2026 年修法前的制度框架。

sources.title: Proposed Amendments to the Collective Sale Regime to Support Renewal of Ageing Developments and Strengthen Owner Safeguards

context.en: First-reading announcement for the 2026 Bill. Commencement is set separately.
context.zh: 2026 年法案首次宣读公告；生效日期另行规定。

sources.title: Second Reading Speech of the Land Titles (Strata) (Amendment) Bill 2026

context.en: Second-reading speech explaining the government’s rationale for the 2026 Bill.
context.zh: 解释 2026 年法案政府立场的二读演讲。

sources.title: Land Titles (Strata) (Amendment) Act 2026 (Act 20 of 2026)

context.en: Published 2026 amendment. Applying its provisions requires the relevant commencement and transitional rules.
context.zh: 已公布的 2026 年修正法；条文适用取决于相应生效与过渡规定。

sources.title: Restrictions On The Strata Subdivision of Commercial Properties (URA/PB/2022/02-CUDG)

context.en: Strata-subdivision rules for the areas and development types defined in the circular. Central Area and Central Region have different geographic coverage.
context.zh: 通函针对所列地区与开发类型规定分层细分条件；Central Area 与 Central Region 的地理范围不同。

sources.title: Gazette of Master Plan 2025

context.en: Gazetted statutory planning framework. Site development permission is assessed through a specific proposal.
context.zh: 已刊宪的法定规划框架；地块开发许可通过具体方案评估。

sources.title: Master Plan 2025 Land Use Layer

context.en: Indicative land-use polygons and source plot-ratio fields. Queensway’s plot-ratio field contains the code EVA.
context.zh: 指示性土地用途分区与原始容积率字段；女皇道的容积率字段记录代码 EVA。

sources.title: Master Plan Written Statement 2025

context.en: General planning-intensity principles used when assessing development proposals.
context.zh: 评估开发方案时采用的一般开发强度原则。

sources.title: Gross Floor Area Handbook

context.en: Definitions and measurement rules for planning gross floor area, distinct from advertised, strata and lettable area.
context.zh: 规划总楼面面积的定义与测量规定，与广告面积、分层面积及可出租面积分别使用。

sources.title: Land Betterment Charge: regime and September 2026 rates

context.en: Land Betterment Charge framework and rates. A site calculation uses its sector, baseline use and proposed change.
context.zh: 土地增值费制度与费率；地块计算需结合所属分区、基准用途及拟议变更。

sources.title: Lease Agreements for Retail Premises Act 2023 (Act 28 of 2023)

context.en: Retail-leasing legislation. Its application depends on commencement, premises use, lease term and signing or renewal date.
context.zh: 零售租赁法律；适用条件涉及生效日期、物业用途、租期及签订或续租日期。

sources.title: Code of Conduct for Leasing of Retail Premises, Third Edition with Corrigendum No. 1; FTIC FAQ

context.zh: 零售租赁守则及相关租约权利，按具体租约条款与情况适用。
